data.statement: (n m : Nat) (lengths : Nat → Nat → Int) (allowed : Nat → Nat → Bool) (u v : Nat → Int) (assign : Nat → Nat) (hfeas : IsFeasibleMatching n m allowed assign) (hv : ∀ s, s < m → v s ≤ 0) (hred : ∀ e s, e < n → s < m → allowed e s = true → 0 ≤ lengths e s - u e - v s) : sumInt n u + sumInt m v ≤ sumInt n (fun e => lengths e (assign e))
data.reference_proof:
apply eda_weak_duality n m lengths allowed u v assign hfeas hv
intro e s he hs hall
have hr := hred e s he hs hall
omega
